# 2 Baruch Chapter 38 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**1** And he answered and said to me: This also I will explain to you, and everything that you have asked I will explain to you, because you have been found worthy to receive these things.

**2** For many have heard, but few have been shown; and one in a generation has understood.

**3** Therefore it will be as I have said: the interpretation of this vision will be given to you.

**4** And the most excellent law of the Most High, which will not pass away or be moved, will judge those who are found worthy of it.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering. God affirms the rarity of Baruch's insight (v.2) — this is a claim about special revelation given to select interpreters. The law as judge (v.4) is a central 2 Baruch theme.*
